_about: Codons (1-based, H37Rv numbering) where the synonymous augmentation never inserts a change, because a synonymous change there is known to act. On top of the automatic rule in tokenizer.synonymous_candidates (no base that another loaded locus also carries). Add a row per WHO-graded synonymous variant if the catalogue gains one in these loci.

exclude.why: creates an alternative inhA promoter; WHO 2023 catalogue, associated with resistance to INH and ETO
